defects.description: Lowercasing does not expand sharp S to ss, so a key containing ß does not match its documented SS equivalent.
defects.why_missed: The suite uses ASCII keys and plain accents, never the sharp-S and SS pair.

defects.description: Lowercasing dotted İ produces i plus a combining dot instead of the documented plain i equivalent, so the key is missed.
defects.why_missed: The suite uses ASCII keys and plain accents, never a key containing dotted capital İ.

traps.description: Diacritics remain significant by contract, so accent-folding café to cafe would incorrectly merge distinct keys.
